name: CatalogList
description: FreeInk streaming catalog-list extractors: JsonListParser (items array + dotted field paths, over JsonSax) and XmlListParser (repeating element + element/attribute selectors, over expat, e.g. WebDAV PROPFIND). Rows stream to a sink; no document is held in memory.
notes: XmlListParser needs expat (XML_*). The consuming project must provide an expat library on the include/link path.
